integrations.name: TMS Tracking Integration
integrations.auth_approach: API Key or OAuth 2.0 (assumed modern REST API)
integrations.error_handling: Standard API error responses (HTTP status codes, JSON error bodies).
integrations.retry_behavior: Idempotent retries for transient network or service errors.
integrations.monitoring: API call metrics, latency, and error rates monitored via ARC_09.
integrations.sync_considerations: Real-time data retrieval on demand; no persistent synchronization of tracking data in the portal database.
